summary: Naaman captain of army of king of Syria great man with master honorable because by him Yahweh had given victory to Syria, mighty man of valor but leper. Syrians had gone out in bands brought captive little maid from Israel who waited on Naaman's wife and said would that my lord were with prophet in Samaria then would he recover leprosy. Naaman tells lord, king of Syria says go I will send letter to king of Israel, departs takes ten talents silver 6000 gold ten changes raiment, brings letter to king of Israel: now when this letter comes I have sent Naaman that you may recover him of leprosy, king of Israel rends clothes am I God to kill and make alive that he sends to recover leprosy? Consider see how he seeks quarrel. Elisha hears king rent clothes says why rent? Let him come to me now and he shall know there is prophet in Israel. So Naaman comes with horses chariots stood at door of Elisha, Elisha sends messenger go wash in Jordan seven times and flesh shall come again and you shall be clean. Naaman was angry went away says behold I thought he will surely come out stand call on name of Yahweh his God wave hand over place recover leper, are not Abanah and Pharpar rivers of Damascus better than all waters of Israel? May I not wash in them and be clean? So turned and went away in rage. Servants came near said my father if prophet had told you do some great thing would you not have done it, how much rather when he says wash and be clean? Then went down dipped seven times in Jordan according to saying of man of God and flesh came again like flesh of little boy and was clean. Returned to Elisha and all his company says now I know there is no God in all earth but in Israel, now please take blessing from servant, Elisha says as Yahweh lives before whom I stand I will receive none, urged but refused. Naaman says if not then give two mules burden of earth for servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods but to Yahweh, but in this thing may Yahweh pardon servant when master goes into house of Rimmon to worship there and he leans on my hand and I bow myself in house of Rimmon may Yahweh pardon thy servant in this thing, Elisha says go in peace. When gone little way, Gehazi servant of Elisha says behold my master spared this Syrian Naaman not receiving at his hands, as Yahweh lives I will run after and take somewhat. Gehazi goes after, Naaman sees lighted down from chariot to meet, is all well? Gehazi says all is well my master has sent me saying behold even now two young men of sons of prophets come from hill country Ephraim give them talent of silver and two changes of raiment, Naaman says be content take two talents urges him binds two talents silver in two bags with two changes garment lays on two servants, they bear before him, when came to hill took from hand and hid in house, let men go. Gehazi goes stands before master, Elisha says where from Gehazi? Says servant went nowhere, Elisha says didn't my heart go with you when man turned from chariot to meet you? Is it time to receive money garments oliveyards vineyards sheep oxen menservants maidservants? Therefore leprosy of Naaman shall cling to you and to your seed forever, he went out from presence leper white as snow.
whyItMatters: Healing of foreign general — powerful Syrian commander, leper, healed by washing seven times in Jordan, confesses no God in all earth but in Israel, asks for earth and pardon for bowing in Rimmon's house, while Gehazi's greed punished leprosy clings. Shows grace beyond Israel and warning about using prophetic gift for profit.

keyVerses.text: Then went he down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
keyVerses.why: Seven dips obedience restores like little boy flesh.

keyVerses.why: Gentile confession — no God except in Israel.

questions.question: Why does Naaman get angry at Elisha's instruction to wash seven times in Jordan?
questions.answer: Naaman expects prophet will surely come out stand call on name of Yahweh wave hand over place recover — dramatic ritual. Instead Elisha doesn't even come out, sends messenger says go wash Jordan seven times. Naaman insulted — Are not Abanah and Pharpar rivers of Damascus better than all waters of Israel? Jordan is muddy compared to clear Damascus rivers. Turns away in rage — pride, expectation of great thing. Servants say my father if prophet told you do some great thing would you not do it, how much rather when says wash and be clean? Humbling — healing requires simple obedience, washing in Israel's river not own. He dips seven times (complete) and flesh like little boy — childlike new skin, clean.

questions.question: Why does Naaman ask for two mules burden of earth and pardon for bowing in Rimmon's house?
questions.answer: After healing, now I know no God in all earth but in Israel, asks take blessing (gift) Elisha refuses as Yahweh lives I will receive none — grace not for sale, and avoids impression prophet profits. Naaman asks give two mules burden of earth — wants Israelite soil to worship Yahweh on, since ancients thought gods tied to land, so taking earth to Syria allows worship Yahweh on Israelite ground in Syria. Also asks pardon: when master goes into house of Rimmon (Hadad storm god) to worship and leans on my hand and I bow myself in house of Rimmon may Yahweh pardon servant in this thing — as officer must accompany king and bow (not worship but duty), requests allowance for accommodation. Elisha says go in peace — permits, shows pastoral realism for new convert in complex position, not demanding immediate resignation which could mean death.

questions.question: Why does Gehazi get leprosy for taking talents?
questions.answer: Gehazi sees master spared Syrian Naaman not receiving, says as Yahweh lives I will run after take somewhat — uses same oath Elisha used to refuse, but for greed. Asks Naaman for talent silver and two changes garment, lies to Naaman, takes two talents (double requested) binds in bags, hides in house, lies to Elisha servant went nowhere. Elisha says didn't my heart go with you when man turned from chariot to meet you? Is it time to receive money garments oliveyards vineyards sheep oxen menservants maidservants? — second sight, prophetic knowledge. Therefore leprosy of Naaman shall cling to you and seed forever, he went out leper white as snow — punishment fits crime: greed for wealth and clothes results in leprosy that makes him outcast, white as snow ironically like Naaman's leprosy before healing. Story warns against using prophetic gift for profit.
